[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVgRF_fxxfUoaWdjEmJnXOZUi2mo9AXD-jVEu2IjmL-Wvj_9DMkof04xcPAjsAtWDsUbxAgfu9s_ueEl-GBbSNqzO20Sw3PHeK1jaO3Xww-EWyREarSRCOFKNO33s5), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAV7usxs9KziO3nXUUjKjLTBtkkXLxpaQ5q-LQ-iC9DAREpVxSUSE4jssaCo7hyXqvHln3UxuGypW2zw5nIH1UbihD4oVeYACNc4Ay7PTwWp73ek4aDjMfKgtiztN4EC4G4R7lxzRv2bPxFqNxPoqFma3g1qGzukw4XmA)]
What is IPTC Photo Metadata?

* Definition: A universally accepted industry standard for embedding administrative, descriptive, and copyright data directly into image files. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHrOzAVa6YL90vCdRk54bfdCqyuYvh4CEovCdFgLnEYnW3vbq09ZsykzLkAgXLUGErTkcuY4uCsxb8pXorV__XOQ0JcYHG2Kgd9ZbyoOqFJqcBn9xqzDUyjQakZoE014-xIBDq1rPZXnhrwS1gzyAN-Qx02xwej), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVgRF_fxxfUoaWdjEmJnXOZUi2mo9AXD-jVEu2IjmL-Wvj_9DMkof04xcPAjsAtWDsUbxAgfu9s_ueEl-GBbSNqzO20Sw3PHeK1jaO3Xww-EWyREarSRCOFKNO33s5)]
* File Formats: Supported across formats like JPEG, TIFF, and PNG, using the [IPTC Core and Extension Schemas](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHrOzAVamozPSLuGtmUTmGz7WwmcSatTV8gSXhP-9rIadeE0o5ppLComWGrJdrdV7r9w8ZPg5AcHt7iiTBh6iqnkKCyxuIZn7Zu32WsAykDeM_t3-KZ1Bf5tz_TdNJ6qLmpFvAlGMzKRlW10KxlAkU) as well as Adobe's XMP framework. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHrOzAVamozPSLuGtmUTmGz7WwmcSatTV8gSXhP-9rIadeE0o5ppLComWGrJdrdV7r9w8ZPg5AcHt7iiTBh6iqnkKCyxuIZn7Zu32WsAykDeM_t3-KZ1Bf5tz_TdNJ6qLmpFvAlGMzKRlW10KxlAkU), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVmh2LShS5MWI7zNanQK48Fy09v-FUYv2fnKOl9Q60zl7NWCKFzXzvAmw_B7hv4YRIkFhcV9ZArqAfLAqhCWvoKppUBtuwrHTa-1FfSdQFDP1Sw-D_tVVoLSju-14i-JNEDTa0OM5CTjm3leteOr04ZieTEQ)]
* Difference from EXIF: While EXIF focuses on technical camera data (shutter speed, ISO, lens settings), IPTC focuses on human-readable details like captions, keywords, and creator credits. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHrOzAV4OaxjMInbnBsTfDNBVPuyfZx3qG_QPAwuA6FUkdWDuhM_hqnEFFXY5HEDP898osmd5eS4Ij5o2s2AvZGP6VBhWtbdEhffhRZTSpOgTS09pI8vTSo1CkN7JlsP-t5GgAO74Oqz2ULN4-gv533xk5Hge5IQL3z66HzPaE)]

Main Metadata Categories

* Descriptive: Includes Alt Text, Headline, Description/Caption, Keywords, and Subject Codes.
* Administrative: Tracks Creation Date, Digital Source Type, Image GUIDs, and registry IDs.
* Rights & Ownership: Stores Creator (Photographer), Copyright Notice, Licensor, and usage terms.
* AI & Content Provenance: Recent standards (such as version 2025.1) include fields for AI System Used, AI System Version, AI Prompt Information, and AI Prompt Writer Name. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFQqPeUMQGV4DdPP7rGUYInuL_LeQuNpiALiUM1bR4IKTJ1rbBFQbcJ_NOqs-g47BgnGnqgaqK5AbUrKuBPZT07T1JmrYBIW5jnrXCwCsozsVyqe1TIiug-6v0v--DpDZvQxWT72pKnr0M-AW97JJJU3qz_0-7ndVehk6RgCvfLSs), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAV7usxs9KziO3nXUUjKjLTBtkkXLxpaQ5q-LQ-iC9DAREpVxSUSE4jssaCo7hyXqvHln3UxuGypW2zw5nIH1UbihD4oVeYACNc4Ay7PTwWp73ek4aDjMfKgtiztN4EC4G4R7lxzRv2bPxFqNxPoqFma3g1qGzukw4XmA), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHrOzAVa6YL90vCdRk54bfdCqyuYvh4CEovCdFgLnEYnW3vbq09ZsykzLkAgXLUGErTkcuY4uCsxb8pXorV__XOQ0JcYHG2Kgd9ZbyoOqFJqcBn9xqzDUyjQakZoE014-xIBDq1rPZXnhrwS1gzyAN-Qx02xwej)]

Key Use Cases

* Digital Asset Management (DAM): Helps archives, news agencies, and stock libraries search and sort massive libraries.
* Search & Google Images: Search engines read embedded IPTC data to display creator information and licensing attributes directly in search results.
* Verification Tools: You can inspect embedded data using tools like the IPTC Photo Metadata Inspector or [GetPMD](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEB6zswFX_cDHQzffcNEF4kmRPyTooc9ZbD15prAJjD2bYe8d6VDdT1V80N9wR4nkcUAYvu4ovpP45OwUkvDYbMb_rZDZxkP7FDXQDQ1emANvOy4NTaIdW11XV41DQVdwTBbX0sr9NVrLZ8I-2nF7XwbVlerxrFu-gtuJ37yqAxpsA5KhUbp-2rMGyfejNn49aGJkXu). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVRTuJN3uvMPelKOVezxw9MlvKudO3GIa_js0R6tGqRdefnGcMQHYIaKQBCvfeQkm3D24fN6OaT_aVvTxeUVfbO-7ERdV3UxHaUkeP8DcCHqf_rXtt2YVQTMMiStZqZ1NpyhcmlmYY8r3RAmNp0P8syA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVpQCmpGd1VSONuWLPH6zOZdwPXJuXoMuMGb_-xkShiGxn-SgZDGD4MvW02CeFNDu4kwMR6WIzJ7bkyONM_w4FvDTUZqeYR8gfExzyCbHT8Wj0Jodl1Kdwrl-pB5ACYLS4WpV_JA), [3](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/iptc-photo-metadata-inspe/ejadeefikdifbfnhokdodfphhkimbelb), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEB6zswFX_cDHQzffcNEF4kmRPyTooc9ZbD15prAJjD2bYe8d6VDdT1V80N9wR4nkcUAYvu4ovpP45OwUkvDYbMb_rZDZxkP7FDXQDQ1emANvOy4NTaIdW11XV41DQVdwTBbX0sr9NVrLZ8I-2nF7XwbVlerxrFu-gtuJ37yqAxpsA5KhUbp-2rMGyfejNn49aGJkXu), [5](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVgRF_fxxfUoaWdjEmJnXOZUi2mo9AXD-jVEu2IjmL-Wvj_9DMkof04xcPAjsAtWDsUbxAgfu9s_ueEl-GBbSNqzO20Sw3PHeK1jaO3Xww-EWyREarSRCOFKNO33s5), [6](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHrOzAV4OaxjMInbnBsTfDNBVPuyfZx3qG_QPAwuA6FUkdWDuhM_hqnEFFXY5HEDP898osmd5eS4Ij5o2s2AvZGP6VBhWtbdEhffhRZTSpOgTS09pI8vTSo1CkN7JlsP-t5GgAO74Oqz2ULN4-gv533xk5Hge5IQL3z66HzPaE)]

The [International Press Telecommunications Council (IPTC)](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHrOzAVdc4J0YPjAFE7402TQcLoVomag0ntvgXv0MewwsdX49Fl4TY25PMUIsjq-OaJZxXmWxFGoIkRqUKUU3zsxXY1Z4EDPi3FbkRlZYqWC-oMPQ) launched [Metawatch](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVnEJCKwVoGoJY2lpNu2kPN60DasqJsg8w8NGhgG77LeviAGWTvQxVkit5RdBSrjfYDVU_cu2Wj8GGSOtSxcXd7gfIPnizaYd2HBDMaL6P), a free and open public monitoring tool that tracks how news publishers handle photo metadata. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV_u-xlH1bbit2w9cDdEKzs3oRW3t5WWw9dq9iYdyG_bFWhl3uP_PGTHKBRlcug1H6gDyTjYUsD1LbWk124FLnYH9AlA_uZerC5hDqZoeMFW16w7XZJ8Uk6Mahn-Cuz-zo6mb2), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEB6zswFTDf7tuIojq6SLCRLrtQHCtaa0fN6msQflnbsWAPt06DZVwv45LSuJnolfFh4p5gFiTIBhtbfRQU-0xwg2llqteEoVozPAA6-PzRHYNItbovz6QpXdgOho1A1JxtPZlwop9oWP3jWcts_vXnPWxOrF4zGOy5RScJiXrZ6pokRPxvm2E3R29L)]
Key Features of Metawatch

* Monthly Checks: Automatically crawls and analyzes news websites every month to see if embedded metadata survives publication. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEB6zswFfgHpcoejsOZHDKvqUMz2dgStI3GenzGcMHH1QvtbbFXfbaZSnGwh-xwCQ1oy_anae2L-AY32YXOlrkz_bVkFwIXmDd7KeOQdOJ-vQH8GCRx938prSApekVdKvZzp4XYKNw0m-gChNfEPr9smIrZRwPx4dHQhJt-fvFU97zDJaG94vzNxUjb0I-8lWeAXRjRN044uHujnGF19S3CsVq7QKPo), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV_u-xlH1bbit2w9cDdEKzs3oRW3t5WWw9dq9iYdyG_bFWhl3uP_PGTHKBRlcug1H6gDyTjYUsD1LbWk124FLnYH9AlA_uZerC5hDqZoeMFW16w7XZJ8Uk6Mahn-Cuz-zo6mb2)]

A nanopublication is the smallest independent unit of publishable scientific information, represented as a machine-readable knowledge graph snippet rather than a traditional research paper. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTAHrOzAV1yR1C6Ffp-mJYbjicBIQjplNbIkm1DPUmGjplHWIHrhfd_KnQTn3nZnd2etExBDERCfJkZKv2Clw6GjnOCm6jj2nsx-gVZk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHrOzAVHHcCYMwchIQdtXG0q8p-tpdrN_-MS1SXUpFnut9sAtEfFkWgmGqLulEfczlsfUNnpcIseOQtly0ECDQBG4tTkw_cojKjZMk9SO20C4MEHaBgXz5rp7zoyFo0wfGsWBmJYw)]
Core Structure
Every nanopublication is built using Resource Description Framework (RDF) triples and consists of three mandatory parts: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVT30WsgNwtI0KXwg-_GIDeC5PLJF7UcX4OWuVacfZntN8sGCKhu_7lSqiGmWLb3sW8xyBUQG_eTof3qFedDl4gD92_ZbHpAfCK6j8muKPrwMO03aveO5z0Uf3OrVVbsLSQASaFQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]

* Assertion: A single, atomic scientific statement or claim (e.g., a specific relation between a gene and a disease). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTAHrOzAV1yR1C6Ffp-mJYbjicBIQjplNbIkm1DPUmGjplHWIHrhfd_KnQTn3nZnd2etExBDERCfJkZKv2Clw6GjnOCm6jj2nsx-gVZk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]
* Provenance: Metadata detailing how the assertion was generated, including the methods, parameters, and primary source or paper. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFb3rkEAMLJU3gbOi0LNmRqtOJ4t07gTM0nmJ59PZ-Q_kHqif2vF3lIGgQI5CsWF4B3fjajhGO5UGTin5prWH77KCf2F1WMQcVCI0YB-6NbFTClr_OZ4BZVrF2tsFlG7-dGyuRMW4zXDjlgWGh6APKxek81WB0kD_SG9c5ftYWHrT), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]
* Publication Info: Metadata identifying the creator, creation timestamp, and reuse or licensing terms. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]

Key Features

* Machine-Readable: Formatted using Semantic Web standards (such as RDF and OWL) so computers and AI tools can automatically search, aggregate, and reason over the data. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVX5UkC9JbjtfWIgkF64MpBAWZI5udRUGD9Di-6-A_BSk8hpnCEXL9-eEbOqYWOAiBG0V2giyYxkH4EYX3PZrkCRsL-whH5WWNR82K6xuCiFRr_Ce82nTEl42SHIuvBuTv1ucNF_la), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHrOzAVHHcCYMwchIQdtXG0q8p-tpdrN_-MS1SXUpFnut9sAtEfFkWgmGqLulEfczlsfUNnpcIseOQtly0ECDQBG4tTkw_cojKjZMk9SO20C4MEHaBgXz5rp7zoyFo0wfGsWBmJYw)]
* Citable and Attributed: Each nanopublication can be uniquely identified and tracked on a decentralized network, giving researchers credit for releasing granular data. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHrOzAV4oAGTmcIh3VH0PN2fT1_9kN8-xSHvrKR7qbaZdoNDloNdhArlyoUAeJPR3ntLZW8hGi07-wdGt9sm62oFtKxLDqjfQpMSC8Npc_FUBC32fXVuPNoA7e2Blkf1IkQYgVJ22S3B8ZLpq-zHkyIKeg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTAHrOzAV1yR1C6Ffp-mJYbjicBIQjplNbIkm1DPUmGjplHWIHrhfd_KnQTn3nZnd2etExBDERCfJkZKv2Clw6GjnOCm6jj2nsx-gVZk)]
* Life Sciences Focus: Millions of nanopublications have been created, heavily concentrated in fields like genetics, pharmacology, and bioinformatics. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVn6dh5sSNnva08Mh7s5y8l0JTOUaDX6nodz1rzdNDjoo1i3PJHS7Aqd_2MKZnVuNfLNEuMpRpsHg1vqB5ebrsJ7avSl3HXtpPYluSMrCGgjYlWtcEJU69L9P3gAsEXKwg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVT30WsgNwtI0KXwg-_GIDeC5PLJF7UcX4OWuVacfZntN8sGCKhu_7lSqiGmWLb3sW8xyBUQG_eTof3qFedDl4gD92_ZbHpAfCK6j8muKPrwMO03aveO5z0Uf3OrVVbsLSQASaFQ)]
* Tools and Access: You can explore or publish them using platforms like [Nanopublications](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTAHrOzAV1yR1C6Ffp-mJYbjicBIQjplNbIkm1DPUmGjplHWIHrhfd_KnQTn3nZnd2etExBDERCfJkZKv2Clw6GjnOCm6jj2nsx-gVZk) or client tools like `nanopub-py`. The [Data Provenance Initiative](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVIs_bBUxr7ducYJKxi6mO2H8PFkOqeMYxYB9BZOGggLJumXN31RQqX2ghNJ2wlF1SU0MHuuvc_7Cgibm_RylNPmv9oYEqoRYseVd3oqu3XZKm1g) is a multi-institutional research project—led in part by researchers from MIT—that audits the datasets, licenses, and web domains used to train artificial intelligence models. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVIs_bBUxr7ducYJKxi6mO2H8PFkOqeMYxYB9BZOGggLJumXN31RQqX2ghNJ2wlF1SU0MHuuvc_7Cgibm_RylNPmv9oYEqoRYseVd3oqu3XZKm1g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEB6zswFet87RYIXm3SERz1TKVCghLBNX4HMFbQtx13MaYHj6MDNSA37R0c7ew2FcMKY0uwIb26y1xAvejdbImAK8Q_LTnWNuKmR8qSQN1qnnLlzv64o7kxJszSYWKAOBs9at3KmLXdTqZoVWPghfJ919vtbMoyd1dBDa3EUPb04SLEOewf5nEuwcxJIK3tbZkdhSMe8_ovQaLxzbMOag7gPLlf4I31cXOb)]
Key Tools & Platforms

* Data Provenance Explorer: An interactive tool that audits and filters over 1,800+ text and fine-tuning datasets across dozens of collections to inspect sources, lineages, and license types.
* Web Consent Explorer: A system that tracks thousands of web domains for consent signals and web policies.
* Open Model Evolution: A monitor tracking open-source and open-weight AI models for transparency and concentration.
* AI Observatory: A comparative tool for analyzing real-world AI conversation sets. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVPyKzeU_QMzOf7n22XqYG0KKTgi5Z-PwZ7GxKjlEAW5l2-E65BnypNfmou0_MVC8loaXdqlCyTHI5KJIgRZIQWyxmBUnIZGUKIrLwEMZt9FHY3wc), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEB6zswFet87RYIXm3SERz1TKVCghLBNX4HMFbQtx13MaYHj6MDNSA37R0c7ew2FcMKY0uwIb26y1xAvejdbImAK8Q_LTnWNuKmR8qSQN1qnnLlzv64o7kxJszSYWKAOBs9at3KmLXdTqZoVWPghfJ919vtbMoyd1dBDa3EUPb04SLEOewf5nEuwcxJIK3tbZkdhSMe8_ovQaLxzbMOag7gPLlf4I31cXOb), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVIs_bBUxr7ducYJKxi6mO2H8PFkOqeMYxYB9BZOGggLJumXN31RQqX2ghNJ2wlF1SU0MHuuvc_7Cgibm_RylNPmv9oYEqoRYseVd3oqu3XZKm1g)]

Major Findings from Audits

* License Omission & Errors: Widely used hosting platforms exhibit over a 70% license omission rate and more than 50% error rates in how they categorize dataset licenses. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVPyKzeU_QMzOf7n22XqYG0KKTgi5Z-PwZ7GxKjlEAW5l2-E65BnypNfmou0_MVC8loaXdqlCyTHI5KJIgRZIQWyxmBUnIZGUKIrLwEMZt9FHY3wc)]
* Composition Divides: Commercially closed or restrictive datasets often monopolize creative tasks, specialized topics, and lower-resource languages. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVPyKzeU_QMzOf7n22XqYG0KKTgi5Z-PwZ7GxKjlEAW5l2-E65BnypNfmou0_MVC8loaXdqlCyTHI5KJIgRZIQWyxmBUnIZGUKIrLwEMZt9FHY3wc)]
* Non-Commercial Spikes: There has been a significant rise in non-commercial and academic-only licenses, frequently driven by synthetic data generated via commercial APIs. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVZJUi_F28cTVTNDyVGy5o6we0skjvkFWVNKew85OiArqy4UZIJs_HB3iYrw47y7IANWFpbJwvPeNn-_KvDgyFI0xIBWwUWyPbE1ituE9-vBcMmutKajo2Z4cvEYj9YNkbsKyOPKg)]

The [Data Provenance Initiative](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVIs_bBUxr7ducYJKxi6mO2H8PFkOqeMYxYB9BZOGggLJumXN31RQqX2ghNJ2wlF1SU0MHuuvc_7Cgibm_RylNPmv9oYEqoRYseVd3oqu3XZKm1g) is a multi-institutional research project—led in part by researchers from MIT—that audits the datasets, licenses, and web domains used to train artificial intelligence models. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVIs_bBUxr7ducYJKxi6mO2H8PFkOqeMYxYB9BZOGggLJumXN31RQqX2ghNJ2wlF1SU0MHuuvc_7Cgibm_RylNPmv9oYEqoRYseVd3oqu3XZKm1g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEB6zswFet87RYIXm3SERz1TKVCghLBNX4HMFbQtx13MaYHj6MDNSA37R0c7ew2FcMKY0uwIb26y1xAvejdbImAK8Q_LTnWNuKmR8qSQN1qnnLlzv64o7kxJszSYWKAOBs9at3KmLXdTqZoVWPghfJ919vtbMoyd1dBDa3EUPb04SLEOewf5nEuwcxJIK3tbZkdhSMe8_ovQaLxzbMOag7gPLlf4I31cXOb)]
Key Tools & Platforms

* Data Provenance Explorer: An interactive tool that audits and filters over 1,800+ text and fine-tuning datasets across dozens of collections to inspect sources, lineages, and license types.
* Web Consent Explorer: A system that tracks thousands of web domains for consent signals and web policies.
* Open Model Evolution: A monitor tracking open-source and open-weight AI models for transparency and concentration.
* AI Observatory: A comparative tool for analyzing real-world AI conversation sets. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVPyKzeU_QMzOf7n22XqYG0KKTgi5Z-PwZ7GxKjlEAW5l2-E65BnypNfmou0_MVC8loaXdqlCyTHI5KJIgRZIQWyxmBUnIZGUKIrLwEMZt9FHY3wc), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEB6zswFet87RYIXm3SERz1TKVCghLBNX4HMFbQtx13MaYHj6MDNSA37R0c7ew2FcMKY0uwIb26y1xAvejdbImAK8Q_LTnWNuKmR8qSQN1qnnLlzv64o7kxJszSYWKAOBs9at3KmLXdTqZoVWPghfJ919vtbMoyd1dBDa3EUPb04SLEOewf5nEuwcxJIK3tbZkdhSMe8_ovQaLxzbMOag7gPLlf4I31cXOb), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVIs_bBUxr7ducYJKxi6mO2H8PFkOqeMYxYB9BZOGggLJumXN31RQqX2ghNJ2wlF1SU0MHuuvc_7Cgibm_RylNPmv9oYEqoRYseVd3oqu3XZKm1g)]

Major Findings from Audits

* License Omission & Errors: Widely used hosting platforms exhibit over a 70% license omission rate and more than 50% error rates in how they categorize dataset licenses. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVPyKzeU_QMzOf7n22XqYG0KKTgi5Z-PwZ7GxKjlEAW5l2-E65BnypNfmou0_MVC8loaXdqlCyTHI5KJIgRZIQWyxmBUnIZGUKIrLwEMZt9FHY3wc)]
* Composition Divides: Commercially closed or restrictive datasets often monopolize creative tasks, specialized topics, and lower-resource languages. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVPyKzeU_QMzOf7n22XqYG0KKTgi5Z-PwZ7GxKjlEAW5l2-E65BnypNfmou0_MVC8loaXdqlCyTHI5KJIgRZIQWyxmBUnIZGUKIrLwEMZt9FHY3wc)]
* Non-Commercial Spikes: There has been a significant rise in non-commercial and academic-only licenses, frequently driven by synthetic data generated via commercial APIs. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVZJUi_F28cTVTNDyVGy5o6we0skjvkFWVNKew85OiArqy4UZIJs_HB3iYrw47y7IANWFpbJwvPeNn-_KvDgyFI0xIBWwUWyPbE1ituE9-vBcMmutKajo2Z4cvEYj9YNkbsKyOPKg)]

[AttributionBench](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVU01FbKjqKLFYWTaNiZYplQ8UQ-cTMSNBjPF8nqEl2y9--9eB-WyrqaP046sOGs1WcXCz5z-vjxbFnIGx2wjxuo7Qo5Q8WmHtkKQlAa5EjDFmUSFi31CF9mMLgtKU2HaYdleBfg) is a comprehensive research benchmark designed to evaluate automatic attribution and citation faithfulness in Large Language Model (LLM) and generative search engine responses. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVmqv2rMzE2fwWGexH4ZP2TmOPFx1x4yOBvoEDc5-2uk21FgRGxqSTveJLXNIK9i_jG2EfxOjIDd-0iwHArcW44frlGDmFVP3i31HMP1TN30TmK00), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVU01FbKjqKLFYWTaNiZYplQ8UQ-cTMSNBjPF8nqEl2y9--9eB-WyrqaP046sOGs1WcXCz5z-vjxbFnIGx2wjxuo7Qo5Q8WmHtkKQlAa5EjDFmUSFi31CF9mMLgtKU2HaYdleBfg)]
Overview & Purpose

* Unified Testbed: It compiles multiple existing attribution datasets—including ExpertQA, Stanford-GenSearch, AttributedQA, LFQA, BEGIN, HAGRID, and AttrEval-GenSearch—into a single standardized evaluation format. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVU01FbKjqKLFYWTaNiZYplQ8UQ-cTMSNBjPF8nqEl2y9--9eB-WyrqaP046sOGs1WcXCz5z-vjxbFnIGx2wjxuo7Qo5Q8WmHtkKQlAa5EjDFmUSFi31CF9mMLgtKU2HaYdleBfg)]
* Core Task: It measures whether every claim generated by an LLM is fully and accurately supported by its cited reference evidence (classified as `attributable` or `not attributable`). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVpZlERTl75IWAAC9-thaAFB3DX_b_T81TUeWKlJZW4_YdoOcnA7wZoHkgXY3Zhbc2_YPw_zVIs-_knsuf7b3o6gPpZYjI3KpLPpPMDvadBfybX5T3dwU_ZEBc_-QNEra_4O0), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ)]
* Dataset Availability: The dataset and code are open-sourced via the [Hugging Face AttributionBench Dataset](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHrOzAVNHLVxrI2cQf_XAnHqx_nRxad9fjvo47I43P_6udYsZree37Tf4h0ThugpBuyHFG3GeSlRkiVwIcWexDwXVFexctl11F4y0phY62RZFAdTEAa6oiODlBMLLZghaBGvVilCCYxJBbUecAC_Q) and the [GitHub Repository](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHrOzAVNHLVxrI2cQf_XAnHqx_nRxad9fjvo47I43P_6udYsZree37Tf4h0ThugpBuyHFG3GeSlRkiVwIcWexDwXVFexctl11F4y0phY62RZFAdTEAa6oiODlBMLLZghaBGvVilCCYxJBbUecAC_Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ)]

Key Findings

* High Difficulty for LLMs: Even cutting-edge models like GPT-4 and fine-tuned GPT-3.5 face significant limitations, reaching only around 80% macro-F1 score on binary attribution classification tasks (and dropping to 60–70% or lower on complex, long-evidence, or out-of-domain datasets). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVU01FbKjqKLFYWTaNiZYplQ8UQ-cTMSNBjPF8nqEl2y9--9eB-WyrqaP046sOGs1WcXCz5z-vjxbFnIGx2wjxuo7Qo5Q8WmHtkKQlAa5EjDFmUSFi31CF9mMLgtKU2HaYdleBfg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVmqv2rMzE2fwWGexH4ZP2TmOPFx1x4yOBvoEDc5-2uk21FgRGxqSTveJLXNIK9i_jG2EfxOjIDd-0iwHArcW44frlGDmFVP3i31HMP1TN30TmK00)]
* Error Breakdown: Analysis of model failures shows that over 66% of errors stem from fine-grained information insensitivity (missing subtle nuances in the text), while nearly 27% derive from mismatches between what the model has access to and human-level context understanding. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVU01FbKjqKLFYWTaNiZYplQ8UQ-cTMSNBjPF8nqEl2y9--9eB-WyrqaP046sOGs1WcXCz5z-vjxbFnIGx2wjxuo7Qo5Q8WmHtkKQlAa5EjDFmUSFi31CF9mMLgtKU2HaYdleBfg)]

segments.text:
The term AttriBench primarily refers to two distinct tools in the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning:
1. AttriBench (Large Language Model Evaluation)
Released in 2026, AttriBench is the first fame- and demographically-balanced quote attribution benchmark dataset for Large Language Models (LLMs). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVkIxAkiiji0QZN3koE1DCdfc3CEbx4E-ATSPWSUnAE_LZatEgP-0kxbgWjM9GK6pJLPpIly8bptwtVAsd7GeX6nDmUOuZqdkS4uPBLtSAaMjvsuI)]

* The Purpose: As LLMs are increasingly deployed for search and information retrieval, it is critical that they accurately attribute quotes to their original authors. AttriBench evaluates how well models do this without exhibiting demographic bias. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVkIxAkiiji0QZN3koE1DCdfc3CEbx4E-ATSPWSUnAE_LZatEgP-0kxbgWjM9GK6pJLPpIly8bptwtVAsd7GeX6nDmUOuZqdkS4uPBLtSAaMjvsuI)]
* Key Findings: Evaluations using this dataset revealed that quote attribution remains highly challenging even for frontier models. It highlighted systematic disparities in accuracy across race, gender, and intersectional groups, as well as a failure mode known as suppression—where a model completely omits attribution even though it possesses the authorship data. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVkIxAkiiji0QZN3koE1DCdfc3CEbx4E-ATSPWSUnAE_LZatEgP-0kxbgWjM9GK6pJLPpIly8bptwtVAsd7GeX6nDmUOuZqdkS4uPBLtSAaMjvsuI)]
* Availability: The data repository can be explored directly on [Hugging Face](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAVFaeIQ7-aMOamfHzfhu2E03kvd9_u_RcgCADRXYNXHQh7F7vkX1__LEpPcKSNIQE7p1oHLf7b6hJ-XNdntf48qhHcTfm-7j34We_QFcZ4pUQv6KC0x_yw_1kp4tKq48NBUMq-8e47MnGmibQ4oquvQNq5ZBKb). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAVFaeIQ7-aMOamfHzfhu2E03kvd9_u_RcgCADRXYNXHQh7F7vkX1__LEpPcKSNIQE7p1oHLf7b6hJ-XNdntf48qhHcTfm-7j34We_QFcZ4pUQv6KC0x_yw_1kp4tKq48NBUMq-8e47MnGmibQ4oquvQNq5ZBKb)]

2. AttriBench (Explainable AI / Feature Attribution)
Originally released in 2023, attribench is a PyTorch-based open-source Python library used to benchmark explainable AI (XAI) techniques. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAVV3mQXXNwbzJCrDspcwiFuSjkIME4y0tt8kUa37mXffVbwQiBDBX3SpkXFSB8GbC--HODQcFtUhxmsw7pkfg15HBf0NxAZJtK_KkkogKViGwNPrRU3xQN), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVp7IeLhzxm3ByrvUus_SmZ3Nqq71kmYOanc0nDlh28UVCNcHRqdrahv6GnFoYCpOat0kVp3lEQZ_l8hxPLHYsiIBGGlV--sOnZkgwfzl4Z09hEU-caQ)]

* The Purpose: When machine learning models make predictions, feature attribution methods (like Integrated Gradients, SHAP, or Saliency Maps) highlight which parts of the input data (e.g., pixels in an image) were most important.
* Functionality: This version of AttriBench provides a standardized framework and functional metrics to evaluate and compare the quality, robustness, and reliability of those feature attribution maps. The term AttriBench primarily refers to two distinct tools in the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning:
1. AttriBench (Large Language Model Evaluation)
Released in 2026, AttriBench is the first fame- and demographically-balanced quote attribution benchmark dataset for Large Language Models (LLMs). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVkIxAkiiji0QZN3koE1DCdfc3CEbx4E-ATSPWSUnAE_LZatEgP-0kxbgWjM9GK6pJLPpIly8bptwtVAsd7GeX6nDmUOuZqdkS4uPBLtSAaMjvsuI)]

* The Purpose: As LLMs are increasingly deployed for search and information retrieval, it is critical that they accurately attribute quotes to their original authors. AttriBench evaluates how well models do this without exhibiting demographic bias. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVkIxAkiiji0QZN3koE1DCdfc3CEbx4E-ATSPWSUnAE_LZatEgP-0kxbgWjM9GK6pJLPpIly8bptwtVAsd7GeX6nDmUOuZqdkS4uPBLtSAaMjvsuI)]
* Key Findings: Evaluations using this dataset revealed that quote attribution remains highly challenging even for frontier models. It highlighted systematic disparities in accuracy across race, gender, and intersectional groups, as well as a failure mode known as suppression—where a model completely omits attribution even though it possesses the authorship data. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVkIxAkiiji0QZN3koE1DCdfc3CEbx4E-ATSPWSUnAE_LZatEgP-0kxbgWjM9GK6pJLPpIly8bptwtVAsd7GeX6nDmUOuZqdkS4uPBLtSAaMjvsuI)]
* Availability: The data repository can be explored directly on [Hugging Face](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAVFaeIQ7-aMOamfHzfhu2E03kvd9_u_RcgCADRXYNXHQh7F7vkX1__LEpPcKSNIQE7p1oHLf7b6hJ-XNdntf48qhHcTfm-7j34We_QFcZ4pUQv6KC0x_yw_1kp4tKq48NBUMq-8e47MnGmibQ4oquvQNq5ZBKb). 2. AttriBench (Explainable AI / Feature Attribution)
Originally released in 2023, attribench is a PyTorch-based open-source Python library used to benchmark explainable AI (XAI) techniques. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAVV3mQXXNwbzJCrDspcwiFuSjkIME4y0tt8kUa37mXffVbwQiBDBX3SpkXFSB8GbC--HODQcFtUhxmsw7pkfg15HBf0NxAZJtK_KkkogKViGwNPrRU3xQN), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVp7IeLhzxm3ByrvUus_SmZ3Nqq71kmYOanc0nDlh28UVCNcHRqdrahv6GnFoYCpOat0kVp3lEQZ_l8hxPLHYsiIBGGlV--sOnZkgwfzl4Z09hEU-caQ)]

* The Purpose: When machine learning models make predictions, feature attribution methods (like Integrated Gradients, SHAP, or Saliency Maps) highlight which parts of the input data (e.g., pixels in an image) were most important.
* Functionality: This version of AttriBench provides a standardized framework and functional metrics to evaluate and compare the quality, robustness, and reliability of those feature attribution maps. Mapping Manuscript Migrations (MMM) is an international digital humanities project that unites disparate historical records to trace the origins, movements, provenance, and ownership history of medieval and Renaissance manuscripts. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV-L1G1zWsKTcIMUl26s2CYS1WC-nLTknJcEXKGVRg3SR18sDkISCW-QchbJ6PSHqNfMF_mUwT70pfkdS5HEmYBhVOxTJ2cLfoElevHNjt9rSEAnkmA03zBz-_k4EbEI917Eky), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVhiimUeIBTse6JWvsBmsU24mXHagnL86aMRmjbyJGZCOFD7-vYmw7Ljh9-LM1mteFS0mFmQ97CFH0vmB35jt2Ad7eFpcK_bEDkjkV3eA0vq8GMSI5jwd1SotonlHnHSTgVSRLm01Qlg)]
Core Overview

* Objective & Scale: Traces the global journey of over 215,000 historical manuscripts from their creation to modern collections, enabling analysis from individual manuscript lifecycles to macro-level trade and collection trends. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHrOzAV9BINJaAaGTfKDbBNmIRJ8cjfAGJ4bc3FUVbxxVTQp1CvkYLWSjtY0RtfuBiDAACnQj_Hz5fhY9oY-qRdz_KsGbIRZA9sRcYv3ufQiSTBYFJ7ueTWnLg4HYYasLzXPI7jXDRrVacPGdIpsdyq1rBBk7Gn), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHrOzAVFVwnPxxYhckZeDS2BUD8aXaAi4K17ZolyQzC40Avsmeq-Qhd7QK4kRCYvWBp2ZxFe2hNdBaTANODbzmEc3HxYg3_DhqfmNx99Q2x6O264S_L09cnDV1aqq9htfwr3M8mVrLtnU23rpOh_w), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVhiimUeIBTse6JWvsBmsU24mXHagnL86aMRmjbyJGZCOFD7-vYmw7Ljh9-LM1mteFS0mFmQ97CFH0vmB35jt2Ad7eFpcK_bEDkjkV3eA0vq8GMSI5jwd1SotonlHnHSTgVSRLm01Qlg)]
* Partners & Funding: A collaboration between the University of Pennsylvania, University of Oxford, Institut de recherche et d'histoire des textes (IRHT-CNRS), and Aalto University, funded by the Trans-Atlantic Platform’s Digging into Data Challenge. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVmBjuFIT9rydIIXbC770wmUabUPGoHPr4yK-vGLkAJZ06_B8qUFNMyGvUVGtvXd6fSouJbWngKjR8F0BFEmx7Ivw-39uRZy58qcy6tc8s7f7t1IC1Z6noyh70B3S4D8o), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV-L1G1zWsKTcIMUl26s2CYS1WC-nLTknJcEXKGVRg3SR18sDkISCW-QchbJ6PSHqNfMF_mUwT70pfkdS5HEmYBhVOxTJ2cLfoElevHNjt9rSEAnkmA03zBz-_k4EbEI917Eky)]

Unified Datasets & Access

The [Schoenberg Database of Manuscripts](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVesmCXyNkU-8dsk0VwPSNwcHVwnl-ZGFBUHgNuuZR3-svu7TVa-utXvqL4MWlTL1C4IUArN2TjlJ4YZ8eo4uZLccUsgR7KceUnzeSl-awda9l9w) (SDBM) is a free, open-access, crowd-sourced digital research tool hosted by the [Schoenberg Institute for Manuscript Studies](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVFcrYiHpkioIRN9Z33mmJEBFf87KerwsXaYDVHIiDAwvHUCTiybU0B7fXz0FF7Pwjv64Mw7IG3mYxRs3S8qu70LvYFrwi5qTwjWn2WUnfs681VCHQww) at Penn Libraries. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAV3vvVKinIyL3mWdjB3ZGlYDa6hUNENyCfZ8bhG_B3spW6AkH7N0xxMWSTdqPM3REwlDvjA1Mtah-8XfpaSKzEzbZOlPeZN8fJr_1RxnZ16em8SWldqMcN6-sLi3jvgosZ7BxHN-pyRs4ifYxfjx9ZzKet6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEB6zswFQ48IwKkfUtmbiudI2xAyCMNlolv_NF6zt8pU-WFiZc6ejmAg_zUXLsvSkEM97E4pPf9aJjHVEirpBjkGL0OYAk_U1q5DN3KhdPuxXReGd9HVDSnNiVuQWDOzeet93saKF5yN4Ojn6UUJUePq0HXKPuIvMVkKYQ8aGneRIOeAloWnW8gcL2L2tmm4GpiHKCbb0eyAdP7vdzh7YjoCig367wTEeV56qTBi0lMw9jAj-q1), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVDnKHE2_PSmKmAbShcSC4s7xvWcg2LuciEdu6rLpS0I3I_gnIMKNP01wcSedLvZdya8y43b15edYRH6s5jR73sVISD5JnXaoJNLVfH5synbehCa6mD7nTG5w65jtOtXVy)]
Key Features and Scope

* Purpose: Allows scholars, collectors, and researchers to trace the history and provenance of pre-modern manuscripts from their creation to the present. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAV0Mz0-mbwraqj8IKCu3RDW89bldt4esdvqrC9tJzvLlKJc_2XmTYsBP-ydn8V94FZ9NzGLnfmNjtOBNpaNqb9Jp3Gm7npaXKGdtrYVSHmbp4JLSEtdoUevd2MUE2fsG9U9uHizxCi), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEB6zswFQ48IwKkfUtmbiudI2xAyCMNlolv_NF6zt8pU-WFiZc6ejmAg_zUXLsvSkEM97E4pPf9aJjHVEirpBjkGL0OYAk_U1q5DN3KhdPuxXReGd9HVDSnNiVuQWDOzeet93saKF5yN4Ojn6UUJUePq0HXKPuIvMVkKYQ8aGneRIOeAloWnW8gcL2L2tmm4GpiHKCbb0eyAdP7vdzh7YjoCig367wTEeV56qTBi0lMw9jAj-q1)]
* Data Scale: Contains over 240,000 manuscript observation records gathered from more. than 14,000 auction catalogs, sales records, institutional inventories, and private collections. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESigEB6zswFRTCq9aBqMjttHajABGm4mJZ1KDv-LabUN2eJu173PjNUYG20fFeio_uR83Q8BeWGZxM-3DmAWgpwCfX0qUpX4-OitqDn2yekLYI395rZ7aOahAnrJpg3c3r0_CbQOFV9xP61Og1uLkLQ3w5BKGsIyryDzFw9cY3eqbvPvs5XxOmHVE-ZnY), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAVh-ADY2u7IkV-9rA5wmvgcjNOMcFahtDNr18ZbeDxX7wbOEYV1k8T_NAhBk23y75tZTEfBtDC6nY4B3amPdQMzei7WPUMAGWjGaP52eihbP4W6KVESfNVxuaX9H0Qh3nLIGWsaFGi0KJVYs-ODLA89GrX03YixgmHSA)]
* Time Period & Geography: Focuses primarily on pre-modern manuscripts dated from 500 to 1600 (though holdings span broader ranges), covering Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHrOzAVXhVfNVexyUNMK4z7KODh49BHzcF7buPnxVsaGr9m9D0zBm8rc1gAj09QLVK_Dfvqe-FUh9G9unsVMx8A_UHzt_PE8uolh-x6eWtzz7ZrrT2J4O84TneniBDEWbO6lHSQEFlJVGwbxL4vOO-jMcZ9Rf-HARD3oi29PQI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAV3vvVKinIyL3mWdjB3ZGlYDa6hUNENyCfZ8bhG_B3spW6AkH7N0xxMWSTdqPM3REwlDvjA1Mtah-8XfpaSKzEzbZOlPeZN8fJr_1RxnZ16em8SWldqMcN6-sLi3jvgosZ7BxHN-pyRs4ifYxfjx9ZzKet6g)]
* Access & Formats: Free to use without a fee; data is searchable, browsable, and exportable in `.xlsx` and `.csv` formats. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAV3vvVKinIyL3mWdjB3ZGlYDa6hUNENyCfZ8bhG_B3spW6AkH7N0xxMWSTdqPM3REwlDvjA1Mtah-8XfpaSKzEzbZOlPeZN8fJr_1RxnZ16em8SWldqMcN6-sLi3jvgosZ7BxHN-pyRs4ifYxfjx9ZzKet6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVDnKHE2_PSmKmAbShcSC4s7xvWcg2LuciEdu6rLpS0I3I_gnIMKNP01wcSedLvZdya8y43b15edYRH6s5jR73sVISD5JnXaoJNLVfH5synbehCa6mD7nTG5w65jtOtXVy)]

Core Record Structure
The database operates using five primary relational record types: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]

* Sources: Catalogs, websites, and documents that describe manuscripts. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Entries: Individual observations or listings extracted from those sources. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Manuscript Records: Centralized hubs that link multiple entries of the same physical manuscript over time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Name Authority: Index of authors, artists, owners, sellers, and institutions. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Place Authority: Geographic locations tied to manuscript production, sales, or ownership. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]

If you are looking up a specific text or collector, tell me the author, title, or provenance name so I can help guide your search in the database.

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAV3vvVKinIyL3mWdjB3ZGlYDa6hUNENyCfZ8bhG_B3spW6AkH7N0xxMWSTdqPM3REwlDvjA1Mtah-8XfpaSKzEzbZOlPeZN8fJr_1RxnZ16em8SWldqMcN6-sLi3jvgosZ7BxHN-pyRs4ifYxfjx9ZzKet6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVDnKHE2_PSmKmAbShcSC4s7xvWcg2LuciEdu6rLpS0I3I_gnIMKNP01wcSedLvZdya8y43b15edYRH6s5jR73sVISD5JnXaoJNLVfH5synbehCa6mD7nTG5w65jtOtXVy)]

Core Record Structure
The database operates using five primary relational record types: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]

* Sources: Catalogs, websites, and documents that describe manuscripts. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Entries: Individual observations or listings extracted from those sources. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Manuscript Records: Centralized hubs that link multiple entries of the same physical manuscript over time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Name Authority: Index of authors, artists, owners, sellers, and institutions. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Place Authority: Geographic locations tied to manuscript production, sales, or ownership. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]

The VroniPlag Wiki is a crowdsourced online platform hosted on [Fandom](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHrOzAVvh3CEJa5Hly3EaBdw8S5Vat9M96rqz6FrURl-bpoVkgcBpAkVxNQhkyyM9zto04GGDtBHJCqUuU4JDhLAVkbHewTMLHgWKPTBivcNsocB1P7b2Zi-3UqfKy6LWs) that investigates and documents academic plagiarism in German doctoral dissertations, habilitations, and scientific publications. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVQvB_JVDGfpp54JF6RL76EqD7KAESQ3377Kqf4XYLGBuDR2scWz2l_1xPPOOiwz4an09qsT1p3cyUWMelnHhHQY1IGy2cReWAoIp3mXJ-Sa0C-OXPmmDmElTN5LwD-9g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHrOzAVvh3CEJa5Hly3EaBdw8S5Vat9M96rqz6FrURl-bpoVkgcBpAkVxNQhkyyM9zto04GGDtBHJCqUuU4JDhLAVkbHewTMLHgWKPTBivcNsocB1P7b2Zi-3UqfKy6LWs)]
Key Facts

* Launch Date: March 28, 2011
* Name Origin: Named after Veronica Saß (daughter of politician Edmund Stoiber), whose thesis was the first project documented ("Vroni" is a German nickname for Veronica).
* Scope: Documents hundreds of academic works with percentage breakdowns of copied text, side-by-side comparisons, and the status of university degree revocations.
* Process: Findings are officially reported to the relevant university's office of academic integrity before public release.
* Recognition: Awarded the Zedler-Preis für freies Wissen (Zedler Prize for Free Knowledge) by Wikimedia Germany in 2012. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAV9Fd7j63ywRpEm1FsW2xtr9_XvdM3JKnEWtSuXJJLGu0IN9lG4M4UvytDUlOx0-tgTxjTPTfVQ7mnp22FJrTNvYfyrnMfDGLFmNytGdLpC2qgPK_zgGVquvBYVzkryBzXdGiyIC1U), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVQvB_JVDGfpp54JF6RL76EqD7KAESQ3377Kqf4XYLGBuDR2scWz2l_1xPPOOiwz4an09qsT1p3cyUWMelnHhHQY1IGy2cReWAoIp3mXJ-Sa0C-OXPmmDmElTN5LwD-9g)]

The [Getty Provenance Index](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAV8-oe1S2woqxskKs-_qW1t8mjwzxn2U8V3fhi_dfzpGAgiehWwwuylLweVqgLbPwcD_0TZxsUeajxtJnzsjnSaJW6-8qW9dvsXlfQXoZRK-ZWzFDOJ0n0yEx6gppdPGu2LiOXM6PPUnFRggHSLmcor2Dmmp8) is an open-access digital database maintained by the Getty Research Institute that provides over 12 million records tracking the ownership, circulation, display, and transfer of artworks. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAV8-oe1S2woqxskKs-_qW1t8mjwzxn2U8V3fhi_dfzpGAgiehWwwuylLweVqgLbPwcD_0TZxsUeajxtJnzsjnSaJW6-8qW9dvsXlfQXoZRK-ZWzFDOJ0n0yEx6gppdPGu2LiOXM6PPUnFRggHSLmcor2Dmmp8), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAV3IeNdF7PplaQgfklaI-3p4RZ2RR_dlvZCDbDPCaMnEw1te2n_Z6UgOj04h_0GJMf8rrhSM5_ownox1khe6veMpzce0kybr3rfiOHZWXMXlGdv7CV_p-4Vpj0is0O), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFZRK-AAMChL8qoKmJUWBj-xw01VgbmeCrmUHaevJ5gHtU9CnAj3mLfIzklBpt_oI3Z982eWkq1gx07bwE4TkSl5OMuvGC2P7oKygeDo7Gw7dNMgQLmxLktTW33Y_1MaEMY_VBgOcefhueAkw_UeZvM90AbnnEJ5OgiuZPw), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEB6zswFdzEgvI8IU4FAGMtmMx-vAlgw3RnDrVpj-B9jdBgXaADZR4eIiQ9-BSMdX7BSIcJUW_aWDRn9eW1ISXqV3pZEK0MqXEDoN161nEAhggKcjeUlqVk2Fwv3pCi-1mlZF5lzqfXkLTHmVir0j1gNoSAz2-9KweFcvSWmzbrR-rsgIqXxlREeXftGBp60MtuZSDH0NDC)]
Key Features and Scope

* Data Volume: Contains over 12 million linked open data records powered by the Arches platform. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFZRK-AAMChL8qoKmJUWBj-xw01VgbmeCrmUHaevJ5gHtU9CnAj3mLfIzklBpt_oI3Z982eWkq1gx07bwE4TkSl5OMuvGC2P7oKygeDo7Gw7dNMgQLmxLktTW33Y_1MaEMY_VBgOcefhueAkw_UeZvM90AbnnEJ5OgiuZPw)]
* Core Sources: Transcriptions from archival inventories, historic auction catalogs, and art dealer stock books. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVymeS4witbwa0ffGoHGmehsmuCjn3ruUphZIgnT0RsCtwXtW-QSkeUOrmSkGE6FctF8rJD6Vl_inBePAvSmQro5m0hEbTxcom6a9PmbURaou34TSFLzr6_hGOdQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEB6zswFdzEgvI8IU4FAGMtmMx-vAlgw3RnDrVpj-B9jdBgXaADZR4eIiQ9-BSMdX7BSIcJUW_aWDRn9eW1ISXqV3pZEK0MqXEDoN161nEAhggKcjeUlqVk2Fwv3pCi-1mlZF5lzqfXkLTHmVir0j1gNoSAz2-9KweFcvSWmzbrR-rsgIqXxlREeXftGBp60MtuZSDH0NDC)]
* Specialized Collections: Includes records such as the 11 painting stock books of the New York dealership M. Knoedler & Co. and Goupil & Cie (covering 1872–1970), alongside European and American sales catalogs (dating roughly from the 16th century through the 20th century). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAVIXGc51NZa_ZDshHYnRG4uNk6hiHUU18ArsL_hIuqmonJFRzKf86Et7Cfx6DkMnRcxwRvJyqAUIp0LlULhLJal6qdVUDSwOfzdr8D8L-6vTDcm7zjVoijmc73qpFk5cqNzfmGjaltizoM3Cz27xU5dkln8pP4), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEB6zswFZj_uNNYjJ8CknI0F882Ug64Q0_54CeDvS37d6WQIbJFhRr1onqRd_IqOHTqTyALkzan1pa5hUBNNYyvA5u3CPUyoBfy0VvWO6dt2I758d9EPDUKTnGXo8XCOUJwUNqMXdS6gSV-tDb7xhgqglUXhYRV84IujiIuZgKTf5GgMOgdgUO2IUrGqLc2vKFwGB-lMZlOZr4X), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVymeS4witbwa0ffGoHGmehsmuCjn3ruUphZIgnT0RsCtwXtW-QSkeUOrmSkGE6FctF8rJD6Vl_inBePAvSmQro5m0hEbTxcom6a9PmbURaou34TSFLzr6_hGOdQ), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFZRK-AAMChL8qoKmJUWBj-xw01VgbmeCrmUHaevJ5gHtU9CnAj3mLfIzklBpt_oI3Z982eWkq1gx07bwE4TkSl5OMuvGC2P7oKygeDo7Gw7dNMgQLmxLktTW33Y_1MaEMY_VBgOcefhueAkw_UeZvM90AbnnEJ5OgiuZPw)]
* Searchable Categories: People/organizations (artists, buyers, sellers, auctioneers), object types (paintings, sculptures, drawings, furniture), transaction events (sold, stolen, exchanged, given), and document/lot identifiers. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAV90DgwspsvRgb2X_Ne74ObbcQAE8g3l22rUaO8_x-JvbunNTpmKk9vGHd-hj453vG8QZDIoIeFg_cBciPhD5YWS1czrRxnyDMoLUuM_iYFaMu7Hgui6xjq5WkV-Ga8347amoZ8JS7vvc4IGr8TqktzjbZ1XYT)]

You can search and explore the data directly through the [Getty Provenance Index Search Portal](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAV90DgwspsvRgb2X_Ne74ObbcQAE8g3l22rUaO8_x-JvbunNTpmKk9vGHd-hj453vG8QZDIoIeFg_cBciPhD5YWS1czrRxnyDMoLUuM_iYFaMu7Hgui6xjq5WkV-Ga8347amoZ8JS7vvc4IGr8TqktzjbZ1XYT). [OLMoTrace](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ) is an open-source system developed by the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (Ai2) that traces language model outputs back to their multi-trillion-token training datasets in real time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVIeW0Bh-S4A2VvhIfG4x5GI442H2AG7c4YT-P8qSUHih41gNA2d_u0ez62uyi0CLMCuDxp107lq0nGROUCWBCMy5JoGWd2CZ7_vNcWWCs3Lu2iFg)]
How It Works

* Real-Time Tracing: After a model generates a response in the Ai2 Playground, users can click the Show OLMoTrace button to highlight verbatim spans of text. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEB6zswFSw37mmS0ky2JdwMbluTG9bXw6YrEyY7-RDR3C6gpGJF1AjuVzgdHaMhPrwWEs6-CqOPaBUaJmKtgKhm0K6DY4dgamujc7BlSKs3Q7zgBXwn4p50GiZOmvHB7LP_ros68_TLow3I8e5BC6voQvexCU7B9RANXq30erTczX0PJp4Eoot_gOSfIdL-s64rEQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Source Retrieval: The tool matches output segments against training corpora (such as the Dolma datasets) and ranks up to 10 context documents using BM25 and unigram probabilities. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Underlying Tech: It uses an extended version of infini-gram with a parallel algorithm that reduces lookup complexity to \(O(L \log N)\). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]

Supported Models

* OLMo 2 32B Instruct
* OLMo 2 13B Instruct
* OLMoE 1B 7B Instruct
* OLMo 3 family (including OLMo 3-Think 32B) [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA)]

Key Use Cases

* Fact-Checking: Verify whether specific claims in a model's answer are backed by real training documents or generated from general parameters. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEB6zswFSw37mmS0ky2JdwMbluTG9bXw6YrEyY7-RDR3C6gpGJF1AjuVzgdHaMhPrwWEs6-CqOPaBUaJmKtgKhm0K6DY4dgamujc7BlSKs3Q7zgBXwn4p50GiZOmvHB7LP_ros68_TLow3I8e5BC6voQvexCU7B9RANXq30erTczX0PJp4Eoot_gOSfIdL-s64rEQ)]
* Hallucination Diagnosis: Spot where a model mixes up facts or memorized text from source files. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVTuCtZhUvlAC1FgYlT-ioaSAfiV6VG-c9osiVQ_FPlF62I3S48qKZjg6PnH3vYzrPeKi7Rar1Z4mDks0EMNRTl8vcyc5d0cIMWkhvQoo_giR_HHzJhHcmcAGkUssJqLjF), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Auditing & Transparency: Inspect the data recipes and pretraining paths for regulatory compliance or research. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAVd9pZK6hXPDhajqcIyrIpeoeKsOtolrBXNH59t2FmwwJ6HuF-YnkP1-EVgZEWX4T7kBh1XIkmkww2H4xJ8oprHeZCLafy4gXrndLDeynguHxNr21pz4Ein_w-Tws5-F6y0jfcbHLurOUXxmovED45PgVVy2GZwu4b7w), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA)]
